title: Covariant stationary Noether charge and Wald entropy

items.title: Stationary covariant Noether boundary data
items.design_state: Step 1 carrier authored for batch 117; local support item added only where needed to prove the planned stationary Noether-charge result.
items.physical_scope: Smooth classical diffeomorphism-covariant metric field theories with a specified finite-jet Lagrangian, stationary nondegenerate bifurcate horizon, globally compatible Noether charge, and explicitly integrable asymptotic Hamiltonian boundary data.
items.statement: Defines smooth finite-jet covariant metric field theories, the selected first-variation decomposition, stationary nondegenerate bifurcate horizon data, the Noether current and residual constraint, and exact asymptotic Hamiltonian charge data.

items.title: Noether charge decomposition for algebraic-curvature Lagrangians
items.design_state: Step 1 carrier authored for batch 117; local support item added only where needed to prove the planned stationary Noether-charge result.
items.physical_scope: Local covariant Noether-potential decomposition for smooth classical metric theories with finite covariant matter jets and algebraic dependence on curvature.
items.statement: For a smooth finite-jet covariant metric Lagrangian with algebraic Riemann-curvature dependence, the covariant first-variation potential and local Noether charge from the canonical finite integration-by-parts construction have Q_zeta=W zeta+X nabla_[zeta] plus the stated ambiguities, with X=-P contracted with the metric volume form.

items.title: Stationary horizon Noether-charge entropy variation
items.design_state: Step 1 carrier authored for batch 117; local support item added only where needed to prove the planned stationary Noether-charge result.
items.physical_scope: Classical stationary nondegenerate bifurcate horizons in smooth diffeomorphism-covariant metric theories whose Lagrangian depends algebraically on curvature and has no covariant derivatives of curvature.
items.statement: For a fixed generator and bifurcation surface, with the canonical covariant first-variation potential and Noether charge representative and vanishing residual-constraint variation, delta integral_B Q_xi = (hbar kappa/(2 pi k_B)) delta S_W, where S_W=-(2 pi k_B/hbar) integral_B P^(abcd) epsilon_ab epsilon_cd dA_B.

items.title: Stationary first law from the covariant boundary identity
items.design_state: Step 1 carrier authored for batch 117; local support item added only where needed to prove the planned stationary Noether-charge result.
items.physical_scope: Conditional first law for a classical stationary nondegenerate bifurcate horizon with the specified covariant potential, globally compatible Noether charge, vanishing linearized constraint variation, and integrable asymptotic Hamiltonian charge.
items.statement: For finite hypersurface chains with boundary S_R-B, the stated constraint, and an integrable asymptotic Hamiltonian variation, delta H_xi equals the bifurcation-surface charge variation and hence (hbar kappa/(2 pi k_B)) delta S_W. Einstein-Hilbert gives S_W=k_B A_B/(4G hbar) for c=1.

items.title: f(R) stationary entropy coefficient
items.design_state: Step 1 carrier authored for batch 117; local support item added only where needed to prove the planned stationary Noether-charge result.
items.physical_scope: Classical f(R) metric Lagrangians on smooth stationary nondegenerate bifurcate horizons under the algebraic-curvature assumptions of the stationary Noether first law.
items.statement: For L=f(R) epsilon_g/(16 pi G) with f C1 on an interval containing the horizon curvature values, S_W=(k_B/(4G hbar)) integral_B f′(R) dA_B.
